review_candidates.title: Accounting And Treasury Officer
review_candidates.description: This is a remote position. Responsibilities Payments: Prepare and process approved payments, verify supporting documents and approvals, follow up on pending or rejected transactions, and maintain proof of payment. Treasury Management: Monitor bank accounts, cash balances, and treasury movements; update tracking tools and support cash-flow forecasts and fund requests. Reconciliations: Perform bank and cash reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, monitor outstanding balances, and support monthly and annual financial closures. Accounting and Reporting: Organize accounting records, prepare monthly accounting packages, check accounting entries and budget allocations, and maintain accurate financial documentation. Advances and Missions: Process approved advances, per diems, and mission payments; track justifications, outstanding balances, and regularizations. Supplier and Beneficiary Accounts: Monitor invoices, payment status, and third-party balances; verify banking details and resolve documentation or transaction issues. Coordination and Compliance: Work with finance, procurement, grants, logistics, and project teams to ensure compliance with approval workflows, internal controls, and donor requirements. Audit and Documentation: Maintain organized physical and digital records, support audits and donor verifications, and ensure confidentiality of financial information. Process Improvement: Maintain payment and treasury tracking tools, improve filing and reconciliation practices, and support updates to finance procedures. Requirements Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience: At least 2-3 years in accounting, treasury, payment processing, financial administration, or project finance. Technical Knowledge: Understanding of accounting principles, payment workflows, bank reconciliations, cash management, internal controls, and accounting documentation. Systems and Tools: Proficiency in Excel and standard office applications; experience with Sage X3, Atlas, or similar systems is an advantage. Additional Assets: Experience with donor-funded projects, NGOs, international organizations, procurement/grants documentation, or coordination with banks and suppliers. Skills: Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, organization, confidentiality, problem-solving, and ability to meet deadlines. Languages: Good written and spoken English; French is an advantage. Benefits Competitive Salary Package: Receive a pay package that matches your skills and experience. Vacation and Sick Leave credits: Enjoy vacation and sick leave credits to maintain work-life balance. Health Coverage: Get medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents. Government-Mandated Benefits: Full coverage of all statutory benefits like SSS, Phil Health, and Pag-IBIG. Learning Opportunities: Access training, certifications, and mentorship to grow your career. Team Engagement: Join team-building activities and wellness programs. Modern Tools: Use the latest technology to excel in your role. Career Growth: Clear paths for promotion and professional development. Inclusive Culture: Be part of a diverse, supportive, and collaborative global team.

review_candidates.description: We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. About The Team Corporate Finance Job Overview We have an opportunity for an Accountant to join our Controllership team where they will play an integral role in our Accounting Organization! The Accountant is responsible for managing and maintaining fixed asset and lease schedules, ensuring the accuracy and updates of long-lived tangible assets master data, performance of account reconciliations, and collaborating with internal partners. The role will also be critical to the timely and accurate execution of close cycle activities, preparing and posting journal entries, and interpreting technical accounting matters related to long-lived tangible assets. Location and Work Arrangement This role is based in Malaysia and is a fully remote position. What You'll Do Maintain and update the lease tool with accurate records of lease agreements and track lease renewals, terminations, and modifications Handle the accounting for the acquisition, capitalization, and depreciation of fixed assets in accordance with technical accounting standards (incl. ASC 350 and ASC 985, etc.) Update fixed asset master data within SAP Conduct impairment analyses for fixed assets and prepare fixed assets roll forwards Perform and review financial close activities and enable timely and accurate completion of close-related tasks Conduct and assess account reconciliations and collect appropriate supporting documentation Carry out and assess variance analyses to identify discrepancies and ensure financial integrity Prepare and post manual journal entries using both Blackline and SAP processes Enable compliance with US GAAP, company policies and procedures, and other regulatory requirements Provide support during internal and external audits, including preparation of audit documentation in response to auditor inquiries Own in-scope SOX controls, including implementation of remediation plans Lead and coordinate activities with third-party accountants to ensure accurate and timely completion of assigned activities Review accounting work done by third-party accountants and provide feedback and corrections as necessary Act as a point of contact for external accounting professionals and to deliver mentorship and resolve issues What You'll Bring Bachelor Degree in Accounting or professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CIMA ore equialent) is preferred. Minimum 2 years accounting experience (public company and/or public accounting experience preferred). Proficient in Microsoft Excel. Strong knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), along with a solid understanding of accounting principles, concepts and practices. Ability to multitask, prioritize projects, creative problem-solve and contribute efficiently and effectively in a fast-paced team environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to learn and adapt in a dynamic environment. Organized and detail oriented. Strong problem-solving skills. Experience with SAP and/or Blackline is preferred. Who We Are We’re a team of creators, storytellers, and innovators united under the Hasbro family and home to beloved brands, AAA digital games studios and immersive experiences that spark imagination across generations. Together, we’re committed to a culture rooted in creativity, excellence, curiosity, and inclusion, and where every employee is empowered to think boldly, act with integrity, and spark joy for all. Hasbro About The Company – Hasbro Wizards of the Coast Who We Are – Wizards of the Coast Equal Opportunity Hasbro is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment. We are committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status. Accommodations If you have a disability and need reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please inform your recruiter anytime throughout the process. Notice Regarding Hasbro’s use of AI in the Recruitment Process We use Greenhouse’s AI-powered Talent Matching tool to compare your application against our job requirements. How it works: Talent Matching compares information from your resume and application responses with job-related criteria established and weighted by Hasbro’s recruiting and hiring teams. Depending on the role, these criteria may include relevant skills, work experience, prior job titles, and industry experience. The tool then assigns a match category to help organize applications for review. Human oversight: Talent Matching supports — but does not replace — human review. It does not automatically advance or reject candidates or make employment decisions. Hasbro’s recruiters and hiring managers review applications and remain responsible for all hiring decisions. Greenhouse has published the results of an independent bias audit of Talent Matching. View the Greenhouse Talent Matching audit results. This is your chance to join a world-class sales team, driving the upmarket growth of a transformative AI solution. Tailored AI demonstrations: Create and deliver compelling, customized demos that showcase the unique value of Fin as an AI agent. Quota achiever: Demonstrated ability to consistently meet and exceed sales targets. Strategic communicator: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex AI solutions. Solution-focused: Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing opportunities across diverse industries. Customer-centric mindset: Skilled at building trust and creating value in competitive sales landscapes. review_candidates.title: AXA Health Solutions - Compliance Officer (H/F)
review_candidates.description: VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Conformité, AXA Health Solution (AHS) recrute un(e) Compliance Officer afin de compléter son équipe existante. L'équipe Compliance d'AHS a pour mission de s'assurer que les activités de AXA Health Insurance et AXA Health Reinsurance sont menées et développées en conformité avec les réglementationss en vigueur au sein des entités françaises Le/la Compliance Officer interviendra dans l’équipe en charge de la LCB-FT, de la protection des intérêts client et de la lutte anti-corruption. Missions principales Participer à la mise en œuvre et à l’amélioration continue du dispositif de conformité Participer aux due diligences, notamment dans le cadre des renouvellements annuels Intervenir en support / conseil des activités commerciales (complétude KYC, scoring client et de la relation d’affaires, analyse de la cohérence des opérations, ...) Conseiller les équipes opérationnelles sur les problématiques de conformité et accompagner les projets (nouveaux produits, nouveaux partenariats, évolutions réglementaires, …) Analyser les alertes de criblage et filtrage LCB-FT et sanctions Contribuer à l'analyse des incidents dans le cadre de la protection des clients et contribuer à la mise en place d'actions correctives Assurer une veille sur les évolutions réglementaires (notamment assurance, distribution, protection des intérêts client) Réaliser des contrôles de conformité (niveau 2) Produire des reportings internes et réglementaires Participer aux comités VOTRE PROFIL Formation / niveau d'étude : Bac +5 (droit, conformité ou gestion des risques) Compétences techniques : Bonne connaissance des enjeux de conformité (anti-corruption, LCB-FT, protection client) Connaissance des réglementations applicables au secteur de l’assurance Capacité à réaliser des contrôles et à formaliser des procédures Bonne compréhension des problématiques de gouvernance produit et de distribution Langues : Français courant et anglais professionnel requis (écrit et oral) Soft skills : Rigueur et sens de l’analyse, Capacité à travailler en équipe, organisation et rigueur, aisance dans la communication écrite et orale, autonomie Sens de l’éthique et de la confidentialité Une expérience dans le secteur de l’assurance ou des services financiers est fortement souhaitée POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux. Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier par exemple : D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ; D’un cadre de travail flexible jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine (selon profil du poste), des tickets restaurant pour les jours télétravaillés ou encore une participation à l’achat d’un écran ou fauteuil ergonomique ; D’une politique visant à concilier vie personnelle et vie professionnelle avec 28 jours de congés payés, entre 14 et 16 RTT selon les années, des formules de travail à temps partiel ou encore des jours d’absence rémunérées pour la rentrée scolaire ou un déménagement par exemple ; De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ; Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue ! VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte dans + de 50 pays. Accompagner près de 95 millions de clients à chaque étape de leur vie, une mission qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin à nos employés et agents (+ de 145 000 dans le monde !) Chez AXA, nous sommes riches de nos singularités et accueillons tous les profils dans leur diversité. Au-delà de mener une politique inclusive engagée, nous agissons au quotidien en tant qu’employeur citoyen et responsable pour des causes sociétales & environnementales. Ces ambitions vous parlent ? Alors rejoignez un des leaders de l’assurance et venez changer le monde avec nous ! Présente sur l'ensemble du territoire, AXA France se distingue comme la filiale la plus importante du Groupe en termes de chiffre d'affaires et d'effectifs. Leader sur les marchés de l'assurance, de la santé et de la prévoyance, l'entreprise offre à ses équipes un cadre de travail moderne et agréable en "smartworking". Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nous avons conçu un dispositif d'intégration baptisé "Welcome@AXA" pour accompagner vos premiers pas parmi nous avec attention. En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : depuis 2020, nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement. Alors, prêt à postuler ?
